_provenance.notes: Pacific Cod (Gadus macrocephalus) is Alaska's second-most valuable groundfish after pollock. It is managed in two separate FMP areas: Gulf of Alaska (GOA) and Bering Sea/Aleutian Islands (BSAI). The 2019 GOA cod stock experienced catastrophic decline following 'The Blob' 2014-2016 marine heatwave — biomass dropped 70%. A Federal Fisheries Disaster was declared for GOA Pacific Cod in 2019 ($24.4M relief). The fishery is harvested by trawl, longline, pot, and jig gear.
